task: Decide whether the downstream periodic response has delay 2 rather than 6 on an 8-phase cycle, relative to the observed driving event. Unknown local clock offsets require zero, one or two calibration links.
counterfactuals: Four downstream delay combinations for the two driving-event contexts; both initial source contexts share exactly the same candidate pool within each combination.
proxy: Optional independent coarse phase-delay measurement: E=0 with probability 0.5, each other phase with probability 0.5/7; observed phase is (delay+E) modulo 8. Its support never excludes either answer.

gpu.dynamic_model: local Qwen3-8B, non-thinking, BF16, structured tool actions
gpu.reader_control: 288 fully observed cases, all 48 test families x 3 regimes x 2 answer counterfactuals, balanced initial context by family; Qwen raw/fact and ChatTS native reading measured separately
gpu.raw_first_action_ablation: same 288 cases, only initial raw source and public driver sketches; no full target values

anti_bias: No test-label tuning or task rejection by performance
All counterfactuals remain in one family split
Distinguish hidden-result oracle from publicly achievable expected utility
No learned retriever unless stronger simple methods leave a substantive gap
model_scope: Qwen for dynamic tool decisions; ChatTS native encoder only for full-evidence reader control, not claimed to be a tool retriever. TimeOmni not required when it adds no comparable retrieval interface.
